text_block_list.text:
While tidying up after training, I heard 
voices coming from the track...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Fuji! How about joining me for 
"seconds" on training right now!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I'll pass. Resting properly is part 
of training, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at you looking so relaxed. The 
next inter-dorm mock race is in the bag!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh... You intend to beat Ritto, do you? 
...Now that sounds interesting.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'm gonna widen the gap big 
time today!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. Is it okay if I practice a 
bit more too?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If it has your seal of approval, then I 
won't hold back...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Alright, Hishi Ama! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Sometimes she gets even more 
fired up than I do...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, that's right. I think I'll rest 
as planned after all."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: What, you're not going to do it?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Taking good care of my body ensures I'm in 
top condition. All to win the mock race, 
of course!
